objective: By the end of the lesson, learners will be better able to apply three comma rules and use freewriting to generate ideas for a narrative paragraph.
materials: - Coursebook: Introduction to Academic Writing, Chapter 2, pp 33-35

stages.stage_aim: To retrieve compound sentence knowledge from Lesson 1 and bridge into comma rules
stages.procedure: - Quick review: elicit compound sentence formula (SV, coordinator SV) and the four coordinators (2 min). Ss complete Practice 2D — write 5 original compound sentences following the directions on p.32 (5 min). Pair share — partner checks for comma + coordinator (2 min).

stages.stage_aim: To diagnose baseline knowledge of comma placement rules
stages.procedure: - Display 6 sentences with missing or misplaced commas on screen. Ss add commas where needed. Covers all three rules (time order signals, compound sentences, items in a series). Bespoke test — NOT from textbook. Individual (3 min). Pair check (2 min). Teacher notes error patterns.

stages.stage_aim: To explicitly teach the comma rules for time order signals, compound sentences, and series
stages.procedure: - Walk through each rule with textbook examples (p.33). Rule 1: comma after time order signal (except then/soon/now). Rule 2: comma before coordinator in compound sentences. Rule 3: comma between items in a series of 3+. Show when NOT to use commas (compound subjects, simple series of 2). Use real ERRANT examples from M3-3A feedback.

stages.stage_aim: To give structured practice applying all three comma rules
stages.procedure: - Ss complete Practice 3A: add commas to 12 sentences covering all three rules (7 min). Pair check (3 min). Whole-class feedback on screen with rule labels. Then Practice 3B: Ss answer 7 questions with complete sentences incorporating target structures (start in class, finish for homework).

stages.stage_aim: To introduce freewriting as a prewriting technique and begin generating ideas for the CA paragraph
stages.procedure: - Display freewriting model from p.34. Explain: 'Write without stopping for 10 minutes. Don't worry about errors — you can fix them later. But try to use compound sentences with correct commas.' Timer on screen. Ss freewrite on 'A Memorable Event' (their CA topic). Optional: share one sentence with a partner.

stages.stage_aim: To consolidate comma rules and preview the writing process for the CA paragraph
stages.procedure: - 'Name the three comma rules' (time signals, compound sentences, series). 'What is freewriting?' (writing without stopping). Connect to CA: 'Your freewrite is Step 1 of the writing process. Next lesson — organize your ideas and write your first draft.'
